title: John P Possible NDE 4065
content: I remember a severe tightness/pain in my chest, and gasping for air with the feeling I wasn't getting air. I remember floating up to the ceiling turning around and seeing myself in bed. I blinked and I was looking down at my neighborhood. Blinked, I was looking down at Boston, blink Eastern Massachusetts and Cape Cod, blink, the east coast of the US and Atlantic. Another blink, the earth was the size of a basketball, blink, the earth was the size of a ball bearing then it was gone. There was pitch-blackness no stars and I felt the most extreme cold. (All this time, I was feeling extreme fear and uncertainty. I had no idea of what was happening.) While drifting in the darkness and bitter cold (wanting my mother), I felt a warmth coming from behind me, Although I saw no body, I somehow turned and saw a fuzzy light, which seem to be giving off the warmth, to what was now my front. (My back was still bitter cold.) I started (somehow) moving towards the light. The closer I got to the light the warmer I got, the warmer I got the more I knew. I started recalling what I thought were embarrassing moments in my life, only to understand why they happened. The closer to the light the less I wanted to return home. It got to a point I understood everything and forgot about my previous life. Happy and content, I continued towards the light. Suddenly I felt a warmth on my still cold back (similar to a loving, embracing arm) which seemed to stop my momentum towards the light. Although I saw and heard nobody, I understood something was wrong, that whatever stopped me was being scolded by something guarding the light. I was told it wasn't my time yet and that I would have to return, and that I would not be allowed to retain my knowledge. I pleaded not to be sent back, I begged repeatedly. With the loving warmth still embracing me, I was led away from the light still begging not to make me forget what I knew. The further from the light I got the less I knew, and the more I remembered my mom and previous life. Again, I begged to be allowed to remember something so my mom would believe me. Again, although I couldn't see anyone, they allowed me to remember three things (which have been the glue that has held me together over the years). 1) The reason for the sunrise and the sunset; The sun rises so that life can grow, and it sets, so that life can rest. 2) There is a reason for everything! 3) In our overall existence, we are but children. This is but a classroom. We are here to learn and to experience extremes. We are here to feel emotions -sadness, happiness, pain etc. and all the complexities that go with them. With time, I have understood this to mean, with experience comes knowledge, and with knowledge comes wisdom. With wisdom comes understanding; with understanding comes a total lack of extreme emotions. Why? Because we understand why it happened. I have determined (The Good Lord forgive me if I'm wrong) Wisdom is Light and Warmth. Ignorance is Dark and Bitter Cold.

arrival.other_being_detail: Felt/understood an unseen presence: a "loving, embracing arm" warmth stopped him; he also understood it was "being scolded by something guarding the light."

environment.environment_other_detail: Pitch-blackness with no stars; "most extreme cold"; later a "fuzzy light" giving warmth.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Led away from the light; as he got farther, he "less... knew" and "more... remembered" his mother and previous life.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Severe tightness/pain in chest; gasping for air and feeling he wasn't getting air.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Rapid zooming outward from bedroom to neighborhood to Boston to Earth shrinking to nothing; then void/cold; then approach to light with increasing knowledge; then stopped and returned.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE included rapid expansion/zoom outward into space before entering the dark void; no described earthlike/heavenly landscape beyond the void/light threshold.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Repeated "blink" transitions with progressively higher vantage (bedroom ceiling → neighborhood → Boston → Eastern MA/Cape Cod → US east coast/Atlantic → Earth shrinking to a basketball then ball bearing then gone). Extreme cold/dark framed as "Ignorance" vs warmth/light as "Wisdom."
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "There was pitch-blackness no stars and I felt the most extreme cold."; "I was told it wasn't my time yet and that I would have to return, and that I would not be allowed to retain my knowledge."; "In our overall existence, we are but children. This is but a classroom."; "Wisdom is Light and Warmth. Ignorance is Dark and Bitter Cold."
